verdict.rationale: Warp says it is built as a platform with an API, says its Automation Platform runs cloud agents from APIs, and supports API keys for headless authentication. A probe found an OpenAPI spec published at docs.warp.dev/openapi.json. However, the pack shows nothing about the API's endpoints, its scope beyond cloud agents, or hands-on use, so how far it lets you drive the product is unproven. Missing for 10: documented endpoint coverage and scope (e.g. control of the desktop app versus only cloud agent runs), example API workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: API, CLI, SDK and MCP built as a platform, not a vertical product or AI teammate.
The Automation Platform runs cloud agents from triggers, schedules, integrations, and APIs.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.warp.dev/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
API keys let the Oz CLI, cloud agents, and self-hosted workers authenticate without human interaction.
